subject: 📣 The Asanathon 2026 agenda is here!
body_content:
We can finally reveal our full lineup for this year's Asanathon... and it's so much better than you think. ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏  ͏ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­ ­  

 

 

Hey giles, check out the lineup we’ve put together for Asanathon 2026.

All times are Eastern Time (ET)

×
ASANATHON 2026 · LIVE WEBINAR
AGENTIC WORK
IN ACTION
One afternoon of real agentic workflows. We explain them, show them running, then build them with you.
September 30 · 12:00 PM
THE AGENDA
12:00 PM
Welcome: The Future of Agentic Work
Marquis Murray
CEO, Cirface
What “agentic work” actually means, why it matters this year, and what you’ll walk away with today.
 
12:10 PM
Keynote: Agentic Work, In Practice
Marquis Murray
CEO, Cirface
No hype, no theory. The three agent workflow patterns that are working inside real teams right now, what they look like before and after, and the one mistake that stalls most AI rollouts.
 
12:35 PM
Panel: What’s Real, What’s Next
Marquis Murray
CEO, Cirface		Spencer Herrick
AI Product Lead, Asana
A candid conversation about where Asana’s agentic AI is today, what’s shipping next, and how teams should decide what to automate first. Bring your questions.
 
1:15 PM
HANDS-ON · 90 MIN
Showcase + Workshop: See It Run, Then Build It
Juli Arenzo
Senior Solutions Engineer		Clara Lynch
Solutions Engineer
One 90-minute session, delivered as a conversation. First the story: a marketing team’s intake problem, the agentic workflow that fixed it, and the before and after numbers. Then the workflow itself, running in Asana. Then it’s your turn: pick the phase you want to build, log into a live Asana demo environment, and build it with us, step by step. Login credentials drop in the chat when the build begins. A short pre-work guide is sent to all registrants.
2:45 PM
Real-World Spotlight: Inside RBC’s Agentic Marketing Workflow
Maggie Falardeau
Head of Sales, Cirface
How one of Canada’s largest banks rebuilt campaign intake and execution with AI Studio. This is the story behind RBC’s 2026 Work Innovation Award for AI Breakthrough, told by the team that built it.
 
3:30 PM
Close: Where to Go From Here
Marquis Murray
CEO, Cirface
Your first-week action plan, plus what’s coming at Work Innovation Summit New York.
Save your seat
The event is free and live on Zoom. A recording is sent to all registrants.

We hope to see you there!

Cirface, 834-2967 Dundas St. W, Toronto, ON M6P 1Z2, Canada
